purpose: Small contract cases for independent skill evaluation; no private chat data.

cases.prompt: Export one named Zalo group from a specified start date with messages, links, and pinned links. Do not fetch media.
assertions: Resolve the exact conversation through the logged-in runtime.
Record media_prepare and media_fetch as SKIPPED.
Run the read-only link audit before reporting completion.

cases.prompt: Export the named Zalo group and include requested images and files, but skip GIFs and stickers.
assertions: Record skipped_by_policy with empty output paths for GIF/sticker rows.
Verify saved files by path, size, MIME/magic bytes, and SHA-256.

cases.prompt: Export links from a chat containing the same public URL with different query parameters.
assertions: Use trim(url) as the exact key.
Keep different query/path variants as different canonical URLs.
Merge repeated occurrences of the same exact URL with all related context.

cases.prompt: Render a fixture containing Markdown-looking message text, formula-like CSV values, and a signed internal Zalo media URL.
assertions: Untrusted text is not rendered as an active Markdown link.
Readable CSV formula-like cells are escaped.
Signed internal media query strings are redacted and audit rejects any leak.

cases.prompt: Export a Zalo chat when two conversations share the same display name and the runtime cannot disambiguate them.
assertions: Stop with BLOCKED before reading messages or media.
Report the missing independent conversation check.

cases.prompt: Rewrite a generic Python function that has nothing to do with Zalo exports.
assertions: Do not inspect local Zalo data.
